description: This source file implements a GStreamer video sink element for Rialto, handling media source creation, property management, state changes, and event handling for video streaming within the Rialto media framework.

classes.name: RialtoMSEVideoSink
classes.description: A GStreamer sink element for Rialto that handles video media streaming, property management, and event processing.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_change_state
methods.description: Handles state transitions for the video sink, attaching media player client and configuring stream info during transition to paused state.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_create_media_source
methods.description: Creates a media source object based on the provided GstCaps, determining mime type and codec data.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_event
methods.description: Handles GstEvent events, particularly CAPS events, to attach media sources.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as video rectangle, max width/height, and preroll frame stepping status.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties like video rectangle, max width/height, and preroll frame stepping.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_qos_handle
methods.description: Handles QoS messages, reporting processed and dropped buffers.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the video sink, setting up sink pad functions and QoS callback.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization, property registration, and supported capabilities setup.
